from Argentina, I wanted to send you a big hug and tell you that we all feel overwhelmed at times by the sum of many sorrows and responsibilities. Just rest a little, without thinking about anything, and if possible, cry as much as you need. Breaks, coffee, a drink, making love with the person you desire are things that help release pressure, as does doing some sport, even if it's just walking and enjoying the scenery without pressure or schedules. And of course, there must be psychologists and psychiatrists at your workplace; seeking help from one of them with the appropriate therapy from time to time helps us focus and find support on more solid ground.
